abductive_moves.assumption: The imperative is meant to externalize a defining proposition, not merely report arbitrary words.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: B001 supplies actual utterance and B016 offers definition, while the name-predicate sequence resembles identification followed by characterization.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: Packet supplies imperative plus name and absolute-one predicate; I infer that commanded utterance makes the definition publicly available.
alternatives: Qul could introduce a declaration without implying formal definition.
Ahad could be praise or confession rather than essence-language.
